summary: Conditional wheel force/torque parameter setter. If enable flag this+0x32BC is non-zero, stores the four float parameters a2..a5 into wheel-force struct fields (this+0x3664, +0x375C, +0x3854, +0x394C). Otherwise bypasses storage and directly applies a2..a5 as force/torque to a rigid body via ForceTorqueApplicationToRigidBodyWithInertiaTens, passing the dbl_7C7428 scalar as the inertia-tensor argument. Called from PitStopProgress during pit-stop wheel operations.

operations.description: Branch on enable flag this+0x32BC: non-zero selects field-storage path, zero selects direct-apply path.
Store parameter a2 into wheel-force field this+0x3664.
Store parameter a3 into wheel-force field this+0x375C.
Store parameter a4 into wheel-force field this+0x3854.
Store parameter a5 into wheel-force field this+0x394C.
Direct-apply path: call ForceTorqueApplicationToRigidBodyWithInertiaTens with global dbl_7C7428 and parameters a2..a5.

unresolved: dbl_7C7428 is the inertia-tensor argument to the direct-apply helper; its exact meaning (single inertia value vs struct base) is unconfirmed.
The four fields at +0x3664/+0x375C/+0x3854/+0x394C are recalculated every frame elsewhere, so stored values are transient (persistence verdict: recalced).
Callee identity of the helper is provided only by name in existing analysis; no callee address evidence is in the packet.
